body: if i wait a while, can this be possible that i get appealed? or will this remain forever?

title: can i get appealed in a while?

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body: Yes, it will be appealable, like all punishments, but I don't have a set date to give you. Make another appeal in 3-6 months and in the meantime don't ban evade.
